properties.name: ThumbnailSize
properties.description: Sets a size of pages thumbnails.

properties.name: AutoRecognizeBlocks
properties.description: Specifies whether a block should be re-recognized automatically after changing its size.

properties.name: IsFormViewCollapsed
properties.description: Value indicating whether the form view is collapsed.

properties.name: IsImageViewCollapsed
properties.description: Value indicating whether the image view is collapsed.

properties.name: SplitterDistance
properties.description: Location of the splitter, in pixels, from the left or top edge of the System.Windows.Forms.SplitContainer which separates document view and image view.

properties.name: MenuStripVisible
properties.description: Gets or sets the value indicating whether the menu strip is visible.

properties.name: StatusStripVisible
properties.description: Gets or sets the value indicating whether the status strip is visible.

properties.name: ToolStripVisible
properties.description: Gets or sets the value indicating whether the tool strip is visible.

properties.name: SplitterDistance
properties.description: Gets or sets the location of the splitter, in pixels, from the left or top edge of the System.Windows.Forms.SplitContainer which separates verification zone and document image zone.
